purpose: A physical, main-deck-rooted bulkhead marking the transition from the Uplink to The Wound.

generation.method: built-in image generation with chroma-key removal
generation.promptSummary: Front-orthographic 16-bit industrial boss bulkhead with riveted gunmetal pylons, magenta instrument lamps, restrained cyan wiring, a hollow central passage, and a substantial threshold; no magical ring, vortex, text, environment, or floating parts.

states.locked: A dark mechanical shutter closes the aperture; twelve lintel pips show recovered Vesperite Fragment progress.
states.open: The shutter retracts. Restrained cyan square motes move through the otherwise clear passage.

replaces: floating procedural green rectangle and dashed circular energy barrier
